title: Desideria Photography Award
subtitle: Munich
content:
During the shooting of 'Bärbel', a collection of photographs was created, which won the new talent award of the Desideria Photography Award 2024. For the jury, these photographs authentically express one of the basic features of the Conditio Humana. Respect and loving interaction with one another across all cultural and social boundaries.
